energy_scope: Nominal only; physical .1keV error retained but not sent or propagated; do not silently infer web uncertainty wire format.
model_scope: FO only, pure component theory, no isotope-A input, no NH/All/E0 queries; the 2008 published default reference is W184, not an A178 nuclear-radius recalculation.
candidate_boundary: These are current point-response R=.66 roots, not the authors exact .07/greater85 result or a new 178W delta measurement. Author near-pure dipole/quadrupole interpretations may also be compared only as pure limits.
theory_error_scope: Record actual printed errors and missing shells; adopted1.4percent includes interpolation; no actual pure-component Cov supplied.
physics_boundaries: alphaK not alphaTotal; E0 forbidden under assumed11to10 but nuclear model remains M1/E2 truncation
BrIccDF uses surface-current approximation; no dynamic-penetration parameter fit or double application of NP correction
Reported Kexp depends on original electron/photon efficiency, gates, angular response and normalization; no actual raw counts/Cov supplied
Do not clip out-of-envelope data to a physical root or report a confidence/uniqueJpi
one POST per component; no automatic retries, preserve failure body and hash; HTTP200 alone is not numeric success
